name: An Earnest Proposition
label: Quest
description: An Earnest Proposition: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hail, adventurer! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you obtained the items I require, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes. That old goblin shall be quite happy with this blood.
Those bracers were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.
